# Meta catalogue rules

<!-- Generated by scripts/catalog/rules-doc.ts from supabase/functions/_shared/catalog-rules.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

What WhatsApp's product catalogue (Meta) accepts, in plain words, as Alo King applies it (DECISIONS §39.15.4).

- **Where the rules live.** One file, `supabase/functions/_shared/catalog-rules.json`: the validator reads it (through
  the generated `catalog-rules.data.ts`), this page is generated from it, and `public.catalog_rules` is seeded from
  it. To add or reword a rule, edit the JSON, add
  a new migration with the statement `node --experimental-strip-types scripts/catalog/rules-doc.ts --seed` prints
  (`insert into public.catalog_rules … on conflict (code) do update`; never edit an applied migration), and run the
  script without arguments to rewrite this page. `scripts/catalog/rules-doc.test.ts` checks that every catalog_rules
  upsert in `supabase/migrations`, read in filename order, adds up to the JSON, and that this page is up to date.
- **Before Meta sees it.** `validateCatalogItem()` (supabase/functions/_shared/catalog-rules.ts) checks every rule
  marked *Alo King* below. The catalogue sync holds back an item that fails: it is never sent (and hidden if it was
  shown), it stays orderable through the chat lists and the web menu, and `catalog_status_report()` counts it as
  *held* with its commonest reason. The demo photo pipeline runs it before saving a photo, and the merchant copilot
  runs it when a merchant adds or edits an item or sends an item photo, and says what Meta would refuse and how to
  fix it, in the merchant's language.
- **Meta's review decides the rest.** Writing on a photo, a watermark or a collage cannot be seen without a vision
  model, so those rules are marked *Meta* and Meta's own review applies them.
- **The learning loop.** Every Meta refusal the status read stores whose error type and title no rule knows becomes a
  `learned` rule in `public.catalog_rules`, with Meta's words, an example item and a count. The next build session
  reviews learned rules (writes the other languages, links each to a rule here or turns it into a check, through the
  JSON and a new migration). Target: zero rejected among synced items.

## Rules

### Photo

| Code | Rule | Checked by | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image_too_small` | Photos are at least 500 × 500 pixels. | Alo King, before sync | Meta: product images at least 500 × 500 pixels |
| `image_not_square` | A square crop of the photo still shows the item: the long side is at most twice the short side. | Alo King, before sync | Meta shows products square; the 2:1 limit is ours (DECISIONS §39.15.4) |
| `image_not_https` | Photos are served from a secure (https) address. | Alo King, before sync | Meta fetches image_link itself; https only (DECISIONS §39.15.4) |
| `image_placeholder` | A real photo of the item: never a placeholder, a blank or an empty image. | Alo King, before sync | Meta: the image shows the actual item, never a placeholder |
| `image_unreadable` | Photos are JPEG, PNG or WebP files. | Alo King, before sync | Meta: JPEG or PNG product images (WebP read here too) |
| `image_text_overlay` | No writing, prices or logos on the photo. | Meta | Meta: no text overlay on product images (Meta's review decides) |
| `image_watermark` | No watermarks on the photo. | Meta | Meta: no watermarks on product images (Meta's review decides) |
| `image_collage` | One item per photo: no collages and no several pictures in one. | Meta | Meta: one item per image, no collages (Meta's review decides) |

### Name (title)

| Code | Rule | Checked by | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title_missing` | Every item has a name. | Alo King, before sync | Meta: every product has a title |
| `title_too_long` | The name, with the shop's, fits in 150 characters. | Alo King, before sync | Meta's title limit as item-text.ts builds titles (DECISIONS §39.15.2) |
| `title_all_caps` | Names are never written in capital letters only. | Alo King, before sync | DECISIONS §39.15.2 title rules; Meta: no all-capital titles |
| `title_mixed_language` | A name is in one language: Arabic letters or Latin letters, not both. | Alo King, before sync | DECISIONS §39.15.2 title rules (one language) |
| `title_promotional` | Names carry no prices, offers, phone numbers or links. | Alo King, before sync | Meta: no prices, promotional text or contact details in titles |

### Price

| Code | Rule | Checked by | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| `price_not_positive` | Every item has a price above zero. | Alo King, before sync | Meta: every product has a price |

### Description

| Code | Rule | Checked by | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description_contact` | Descriptions have no phone numbers, links or email addresses. | Alo King, before sync | Meta: no phone numbers, links or emails in descriptions |
| `description_promotional` | Descriptions have no promotional text: no “free”, “discount”, “best price”, “!!!” or rows of emoji. | Alo King, before sync | Meta: no promotional text in descriptions |

### Commerce policy

| Code | Rule | Checked by | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policy_medicine` | No medicines or pharmacy products: selling them through delivery apps is illegal in Lebanon (Order of Pharmacists, 2 June 2026). | Alo King, before sync | DECISIONS §38.3 (Order of Pharmacists, 2 June 2026); Meta commerce policy |
| `policy_alcohol` | No alcohol in the WhatsApp catalogue (Meta's commerce policy; Alo King never lists alcohol). | Alo King, before sync | Meta commerce policy; Alo King never lists alcohol (alcohol.ts) |
| `policy_tobacco` | No tobacco, cigarettes, shisha tobacco or vapes in the WhatsApp catalogue (Meta's commerce policy). | Alo King, before sync | Meta commerce policy |

## العربية (ar)

- `image_too_small`: الصورة لازم تكون 500 × 500 بيكسل عالأقل.
- `image_not_square`: لازم الصورة تنقصّ مربّعة ويضل الصنف باين: الطول مش أكتر من ضعف العرض.
- `image_not_https`: الصورة لازم تكون على عنوان آمن (https).
- `image_placeholder`: صورة حقيقية للصنف: مش صورة بديلة أو فاضية.
- `image_unreadable`: الصورة لازم تكون JPEG أو PNG أو WebP.
- `image_text_overlay`: ما في كتابة أو أسعار أو لوغو عالصورة.
- `image_watermark`: ما في علامة مائية (watermark) عالصورة.
- `image_collage`: صنف واحد بالصورة: ما في كولاج أو كذا صورة بصورة وحدة.
- `title_missing`: كل صنف إلو اسم.
- `title_too_long`: الاسم مع اسم المحل ما بيزيد عن 150 حرف.
- `title_all_caps`: الأسماء ما بتنكتب كلها بأحرف كبيرة (CAPS).
- `title_mixed_language`: الاسم بلغة وحدة: يا عربي يا أحرف لاتينية، مش الاتنين سوا.
- `title_promotional`: ما في أسعار أو عروض أو أرقام تلفون أو روابط بالاسم.
- `price_not_positive`: كل صنف إلو سعر أكتر من صفر.
- `description_contact`: ما في أرقام تلفون أو روابط أو إيميل بالوصف.
- `description_promotional`: ما في كلام دعاية بالوصف: لا «ببلاش» ولا «خصم» ولا «أفضل سعر» ولا «!!!» ولا إيموجي كتير.
- `policy_medicine`: ما في أدوية أو منتجات صيدلية: بيعها عبر تطبيقات التوصيل ممنوع بلبنان (نقابة الصيادلة، 2 حزيران 2026).
- `policy_alcohol`: ما في كحول بكاتالوج واتساب (سياسة Meta؛ وAlo King ما بيعرض كحول أبداً).
- `policy_tobacco`: ما في دخان أو سجائر أو تنباك أو فيب بكاتالوج واتساب (سياسة Meta).

## Français (fr)

- `image_too_small`: Les photos font au moins 500 × 500 pixels.
- `image_not_square`: Un recadrage carré montre encore l'article : le grand côté fait au plus deux fois le petit.
- `image_not_https`: Les photos sont servies depuis une adresse sécurisée (https).
- `image_placeholder`: Une vraie photo de l'article : jamais une image d'attente, vide ou blanche.
- `image_unreadable`: Les photos sont des fichiers JPEG, PNG ou WebP.
- `image_text_overlay`: Pas de texte, de prix ni de logo sur la photo.
- `image_watermark`: Pas de filigrane sur la photo.
- `image_collage`: Un article par photo : pas de collage ni plusieurs images en une.
- `title_missing`: Chaque article a un nom.
- `title_too_long`: Le nom, avec celui du commerce, tient en 150 caractères.
- `title_all_caps`: Les noms ne sont jamais écrits tout en majuscules.
- `title_mixed_language`: Un nom est dans une seule langue : lettres arabes ou latines, pas les deux.
- `title_promotional`: Les noms ne contiennent ni prix, ni offre, ni numéro de téléphone, ni lien.
- `price_not_positive`: Chaque article a un prix supérieur à zéro.
- `description_contact`: Les descriptions ne contiennent ni numéro de téléphone, ni lien, ni e-mail.
- `description_promotional`: Les descriptions n'ont pas de texte promotionnel : ni « gratuit », ni « remise », ni « meilleur prix », ni « !!! », ni rangées d'emoji.
- `policy_medicine`: Pas de médicaments ni de produits de pharmacie : les vendre par une application de livraison est illégal au Liban (Ordre des pharmaciens, 2 juin 2026).
- `policy_alcohol`: Pas d'alcool dans le catalogue WhatsApp (politique commerciale de Meta ; Alo King ne liste jamais d'alcool).
- `policy_tobacco`: Pas de tabac, cigarettes, tabac à chicha ni vapoteuses dans le catalogue WhatsApp (politique commerciale de Meta).
